# AI PATH program illustrations

Generated with imagegen on 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-03 using the existing AI PATH neural-course illustration as a style reference. Individual prompts are recorded in `prompts.json`. These are editorial illustrations, not project screenshots or technical diagrams. Original project previews and their attribution remain unchanged.

Each illustration has a 1536×1024 WebP and a 640×427 menu rendition. PNG generation masters are retained in the local production package.
